The native planner did not receive a screenshot or the focused composer control. The last captured Fara proposal was the initial Return for Gmail navigation.

No recipient, subject, body or attachment was populated. Draft count remained 23. One blank test draft was discarded, then only the owned Gmail window was closed, restoring original Drive window.
live03.limits: Capture archive caps at 20 native exchanges; not a claim that only 20 attempts occurred. No screenshot/upload/completion acceptance.

focusedControlRepair.problem: A bounded native page could omit the active form control and keep proposing unrelated page controls. Gmail live03 repeated Compose.
focusedControlRepair.change: Serialize AXComboBox and require a focused page control to be represented. Reject unsafe/unknown focus ancestry and capture-time focus changes. Clearly scoped browser chrome and noncontrol focus remain readable. Use the existing nil-page fresh screenshot fallback; no site rules or increased budgets.
focusedControlRepair.verification: RED reproduced 7 assertion failures. GREEN passed all 23 focused methods with no skips or runtime issues. Live04 used Fara after one native Compose proposal; the exact nil-page cause was not separately instrumented.
focusedControlRepair.harnessChange: Exact-point Attach files approval and final draft evidence no longer depend on the capped PageReader. Approval still requires observed enabled Attach files, protected-content exclusions, current Gmail URL, exact retained foreground window, and subsequent exact-file picker confirmation. Removed an extra period from the test goal body.
focusedControlRepair.accepted: Focused observation/fallback component only; Gmail workflow remains unaccepted.
